title: Note App
description: A simple note taking app with a focus on privacy and security.
problem: I needed a simple note taking app with privacy and security features.
solution: I built a note taking app with a focus on privacy and security.
architecture: A Django backend stores user data and encrypts notes with JWT encryption.

title: Agricultural Web App
description: A web app for farmers to monitor plant health and nutrient deficiencies.
problem: I needed a web app for farmers to monitor plant health and nutrient deficiencies.
solution: I built a web app for farmers to monitor plant health and nutrient deficiencies.
architecture: A Sleek UI built with React and Tailwind CSS provides real-time insights into plant health and nutrient deficiencies.

title: Disease Detection
description: A vision model for identifying disease markers in pathology and medical imagery with explainable confidence scoring.
problem: Early detection required both speed and interpretability for non-specialist operators.
solution: I fine-tuned a vision model with saliency overlays and a lightweight API for clinical review.
architecture: A PyTorch inference service produces confidence scores and highlight overlays for multiple image modalities.
lessons: Human review is part of the system

title: LLM Chatbot Platform
description: A secure, multilingual chatbot platform designed for onboarding, support, and knowledge retrieval.
problem: Support teams needed a scalable, configurable assistant that could be extended without code churn.
solution: I built a modular chatbot orchestration system with role-based access, tool integrations, and prompt governance.
architecture: A React frontend connects to a Node service that orchestrates prompts, tools, and workflow state.

title: Vision Models Lab
description: An experimentation studio for deploying segmentation, detection, and classification models across production pipelines.
problem: Research prototypes needed a path from notebook experiments to robust API deployment.
solution: I packaged the best-performing models into containerized services with benchmark regression tests.
architecture: An inference gateway routes requests to model containers and stores evaluation metrics for comparison.

title: Recommendation Engines
description: A high-throughput recommendation engine for personalized content discovery with feedback loops.
problem: Users were overwhelmed by generic content and needed more relevant experiences.
solution: I built a hybrid ranker that combines collaborative filtering and content-aware signals.
architecture: An online serving layer reads from a feature store and caches personalized rankings in Redis.
lessons: Offline metrics and live metrics diverge

title: Fraud Detection Platform
description: A behavioral analytics platform that identifies suspicious patterns and flags anomaly score changes in near real time.
problem: Manual review processes were too slow for rapidly changing fraud behavior.
solution: I built event-driven anomaly detection with alerting and investigation workflows for analysts.
architecture: A streaming ingestion layer feeds Python scoring services and a dashboard for case investigation.
